title: EP_progressive_lod mesh LOD entry
description: One level-of-detail variant of a mesh primitive. Either sibling-file (inline/path) or single-glb-range (bufferView) form, depending on the extension's storage mode.

ratio.description: Decimation ratio relative to the source mesh.

inline.description: sibling-file mode: true when this LOD is the coarse base packed inline in the root asset.

path.description: sibling-file mode: path to the sibling LOD file, relative to the root asset.

bufferView.description: single-glb-range mode: index of the bufferView holding this LOD's indices/attributes.

decodeAABB.description: Optional [min,max] AABB used to dequantize position attributes back to mesh-local space.
